method: Direct visual inspection of both pixel-distinct 900x1350 WebPs for each place in the CI portrait contact sheet, cross-checked against verified original source metadata and SHA-256 list.

constraints.note: A candidate with PASS_FRAMING is visually selected, not a published frontImage; copy the reviewed artifact bytes, preserve author/licence/source and check PlaceCard/browser before raising release gate.

per_place.author: Helge Høifødt
per_place.finding: Horizontal offset recovers more of the historic white facade and reduces the tree's dominance; garden and building remain clearly identifiable.

per_place.author: Kjetil Ree
